reportedFacts.quote: 2025 annual report PDF pages 3, 46-51, 95 and 99; FY2016 parent equity, separately identified preferred, and annual statement amounts. Historical summary amounts rounded to USD million.
reportedFacts.calculation: Revenue = insurance revenue + non-insurance revenue + interest/dividends + share of profit of associates + net investment gains. Annual equity is parent equity including preferred but excluding noncontrolling interests; preferred is separately stored, so commonBook subtracts it once. Current-common balance explicitly excludes preferred. Earnings fields distinguish parent and common.
